m: Cut the chuck into large 4cm chunks, season with salt and brown hard in a heavy pot in batches. Set aside.
Lower the heat, add a splash of oil and fry the curry paste for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the coconut milk, half a cup of water per 2 serves, the fish sauce and brown sugar. Return the beef and bring to a gentle simmer.
Lid on, low heat (or 160°C oven) for 2 hours, stirring occasionally.
Add the potato in chunks and the onion in wedges. Simmer uncovered 30 to 40 minutes until the potato is tender and the beef falls apart.
Taste: adjust with more fish sauce for salt, sugar for sweet, lime for sour. Cook the rice.
Serve over rice, topped with crushed peanuts and coriander.
l: Even better the next day. Pack the peanuts separately so they stay crunchy.
g: Naturally gluten free. Check the curry paste and fish sauce labels.
